description_for_model: Source-bound cryptocurrency platform research API. Compares published base fee scenarios, checks domain legitimacy against NexuAlpha's official-domain registry, and returns Proof-of-Reserves review status as unknown or pending unless an official source has been reviewed. It does not verify rebates, certify reserve adequacy, or choose an exchange for the user.
description_for_human: Compare published crypto platform fee scenarios, check official domains, and review source-bound PoR status notes.

tools.name: get_lowest_fee_route
tools.description: Returns a source-bound comparison of published base fee scenarios based on 30-day trading volume and market type. It does not verify rebates, account-tier discounts, liquidity, spreads, slippage, or final signup terms.

tools.name: verify_exchange_domain
tools.description: Validates a URL or domain against NexuAlpha's official-domain registry and returns whether the domain matches a known official venue domain.

domain.description: Hostname or domain to check, e.g. 'binance.com' or 'okx.com'.

tools.name: get_por_status
tools.description: Returns source-bound Proof-of-Reserves review status. Unknown or unreviewed reserve, audit, and protection-fund claims remain pending and must be checked against the venue's current official disclosure.
